clauses.clause: Corpses persist for the whole level (no removal for perf). Piles settle on each other: no floating bodies, no stretched/spiky limbs, pile height ≤ ~1 m (orch. default until F-293 "climbable pile" is scheduled).
clauses.note: Fresh pooled WebGL2 low/high authored ten-corpse fixture: all10 IDs persist at ticks120 and7320 (122s), layout maxLift0.22m and5 heap pairs. Personally opened all12 original1280x720 captures. FAIL: overlap-z0.5 at both tiers shows the center-left dark-clothed corpse with broad pointed stretched skin panels around torso/upper arms; the front dark-clothed corpse also has sharp elongated forearm/hand folds. These remain in tick7320 close views. Persistence passes; the explicit no stretched/spiky limbs clause fails. Repro: SCENE_PORT=4834 BROWSER_POOL_JOB_ID=rr-b node --import tsx/esm tools/qa/blk-v-captures.mjs G14 rr-b low (repeat high).
